name: Upgrade Ant javac source/target from 1.5 to 1.6
description: Ant build.xml specifies javac source=1.5 and target=1.5. These must be updated to 1.6.

patterns.reason: Update Java source and target compatibility from 1.5 to 1.6

verification_hint: Check that build.xml javac tasks use source=1.6 and target=1.6 and compilation succeeds on Java 6.

name: Java 6 enforces stricter cast checking per JLS
description: Java SE 6 casts adhere more closely to JLS. Previously accepted incorrect programs may be rejected by Java 6 javac.

patterns.reason: Java 6 enforces stricter cast rules. Complex casts should be reviewed.

verification_hint: Compile with Java 6 javac and ensure no new type incompatibility errors appear.
